training.read: Token NLL improved quickly while control MAE barely moved; later epochs overfit hard.

mechanism_read: The future control-state sequence restored conditional spread allocation and short-horizon coverage, but it did not become a usable path-shape controller. It behaved more like a volatility allocator than a mean/path allocator, leaving mean reversion and level-law structure effectively dead.
decision: Treat 295a as the last justified in-paradigm experiment for the fixed-horizon one-stage joint-law line. Next step: paradigm-shift analysis.
